title: Analysis code and aggregated outputs: Meal-affordability deprivation (a single-item proxy for food insecurity), income poverty and targeting rules in Türkiye (ILCS 2023–2025)
description: Analysis code and aggregated outputs for a study of household meal-affordability deprivation (a single-item proxy for food insecurity) and relative income poverty in Türkiye, based on the 2023–2025 cross-sections of the Income and Living Conditions Survey (ILCS/EU-SILC, Turkish Statistical Institute). The pipeline (R 4.6.1 and Python 3.13) estimates the exclusion error of the 60% relative poverty line, compares targeting rules trained on 2023–2024 and evaluated on 2025, and standardizes dietary frequencies by g-computation. The repository contains the full analysis code, the written analysis protocol, the trained ridge and lasso logistic models with their preprocessing parameters and aggregated outputs; trained gradient-boosting models are not distributed, and the TurkStat microdata cannot be redistributed and are available through TurkStat's official microdata procedures. A manuscript describing the analysis is under review.
